title: Folk Songs of the States
content_zh:
Gone is the youth, who left in spring.
When will he return from his wandering?
The mulberry fields stretch green and vast.
Young girl, do not be too forward in love.
For a man may love and still walk away.
But when a maiden loves, no one pities her.
